name: Eisenschmidt
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Eisenschmidt in Füssen** – a historic inn with over 500 years of tradition, nestled in the heart of the **Allgäu** region. Just a short stroll from **Neuschwanstein Castle**, this cozy guesthouse invites you to experience authentic Bavarian hospitality.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy pancake torn into pieces and served with powdered sugar and fresh fruit. Pair it with a glass of crisp **Allgäuer Bier** or a warm cup of **Kaffee und Kuchen** on our sunlit terrace.

After a day of exploring the **Alps**, relax in our rustic **Stube** with a roaring fireplace or unwind in our tranquil garden. Whether you're here for adventure, culture, or simply good food, Eisenschmidt offers a warm retreat in the heart of **Tirol**’s most picturesque landscapes.

**Reservierungen** (reservations) are recommended—especially in peak season!
